ns2:section.sectionText: Humanities majors will learn vital skills for getting jobs after graduation. Field trips to local organizations and businesses, networking opportunities, and invited speakers will expose students to the breadth of opportunities available to them. This course will prepare students to translate the skills they gain in their major to a wide range of careers.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Linguistics or History of Art or E Asian Languages & Cultures or German or Italian or Classics or English or Philosophy or History or African American Studies or Comparative Literature or Gender and Women's Studies or Interdisciplinary or Latina/Latino Studies or Religion or Portuguese or Spanish or Russian Lang & Literature or Creative Writing or Slavic Studies major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
